source_title: Arizona A.A.C. Title 17, Chapter 6 — Oversize and Overweight Special Permits (ADOT)
verify_reasons: Escort matrix, superload/Class-C envelope and movement curfews were read from the verbatim A.A.C. Title 17 Ch. 6 rule text; ADOT's own server (azdot.gov PDFs, apps.azsos.gov Title 17) returned HTTP 403 this run, so text was confirmed from a faithful reproduction of the same administrative code.

Fee figures (OS $15 / OW $75 single-trip, Class C review/engineering add-ons) were read from the 2013 A.A.C. supplement text; ADOT promulgated an 'Envelope and Special Permit' amendment effective 2022-07-08 that could not be retrieved — confirm current fee amounts with ADOT before dispatch.

superload_thresholds.note: Arizona's standard non-reducible (Class A) permit envelope tops out at 14' wide, 16' high, 120' overall length and 250,000 lbs (A.A.C. R17-6-201); loads exceeding these fall to Class C special handling. Engineering/structural (bridge) review is mandatory over 250,000 lbs or over axle-group/bridge weight limits (R17-6-104). Night/continuous-travel envelope caps at 16' wide, 16' high, 120' long, 250,000 lbs.

width.note: front and rear escort over 14' up to 16' wide
Class C special handling over 16' wide; escorts and any DPS traffic control set case-by-case (R17-6-306/108)

height.note: front escort with height pole over 15' high; utility notification required over 16' (R17-6-308)

single_trip.fee_formula: Oversize (over-dimension, weight <= 80,000 lbs) single trip = $15; overweight (> legal, < 250,000 lbs) single trip = $75 (A.A.C. R17-6-201). Class C (superload) adds a review/analysis fee of $15 (<=18' H/W) or $25 (>18'), plus engineering analysis at $75 per 50-mile increment (non-ADOT engineer) or $125 per 50-mile increment (ADOT engineer) per R17-6-204. Fees are from the 2013 A.A.C. text and may have been revised by the 2022 amendment.
single_trip.note: Single-trip permits valid 96 hours; 30-day and annual class permits also available.

annual.note: Class-specific annual permits: Class B non-reducible $360/yr; Class D self-propelled crane/drill $600/yr; envelope annual oversize-only $750, oversize+overweight $1,500; overwidth watercraft $45/yr (A.A.C. R17-6-201 through -210).

movement_restrictions: Daylight movement only — no earlier than 1/2 hour before sunrise and no later than 1/2 hour after sunset unless the Department authorizes alternate hours (R17-6-401); stay in the rightmost lane on multilane highways except to pass

Metro curfew (loads over 10' wide) 7:00-9:00 AM and 4:00-6:00 PM Mon-Fri on listed Phoenix (I-10, I-17, SR 51/143, US 60, loops SR 101/202), Tucson (I-10, I-19, SR 77/86) and Yuma (US 95, I-8) routes; over 12' wide no transport on Phoenix loops during curfew (R17-6-404)
No transport on New Year's Day, Memorial Day, Independence Day, Labor Day, Thanksgiving or Christmas for loads over 10' wide / 14'6" high / 120' overall (R17-6-406)
No transport when visibility is under 500 ft (dust, snow, fog, heavy rain), when traction is reduced, or when high winds destabilize the load (R17-6-403)
notes: Legal width 8'6", height 14'0", gross 80,000 lbs (5+ axles) per A.R.S. 28-1093/1094/1100. Semitrailer 57'6" on Interstate / 53' on other highways; 53' used here as the conservative field.
Front or rear load projection exceeding 20' triggers a front/rear escort respectively (R17-6-307); 'OVERSIZE LOAD' sign required at width 9' or more (R17-6-303).
